name: grizzly-gbp-poster
description: Local Grizzly Google Business Profile posting workflow for OneDrive photo intake, workbook approval, posting, and monthly archive cleanup.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare, approve, post, and archive Grizzly Google Business Profile updates.
interface.longDescription: Scans OneDrive phone photos for usable electrical job images, copies good candidates into a curated Google Business Profile folder, prepares spreadsheet rows for approval, posts approved rows, and archives used photos to OneDrive online-only storage each month.
defaultPrompt: Scan my new OneDrive photos for Grizzly GBP candidates.
Prepare today's Google Business Profile post for approval.
Archive last month's used GBP post photos and mark them online-only.
